kicker: South of Gran Canaria · San Bartolomé de Tirajana · Mogán
h1:
We don't just rent homes.
We put your property to work.
lede: See how your home is doing every week: clean, maintained and earning.
s1: We only get paid when your home is active
d1.s: I want it working, not empty
cierre: This is what an active home looks like from 3,000 km away. What about yours?
a2.ante: We know why you keep it locked up
a2.h: It's not the money. It's the fear.
a2.m1t: That you won't get it back
a2.m1p: Short, seasonal contracts, with the reason documented. Never long-term lets. Your home is yours again on the date you set.
a2.m2p: We go in after every stay. If something breaks, we repair or replace it ourselves.
a2.m3p: A video and a report on your home after every changeover. Without you asking, and without ringing anyone.
a3.p1b: 1 · We get to know each other.
a3.p1s: You message us on WhatsApp and we reply in your language. No obligation.
a3.p2s: Licence, regulations and which contract it allows. Free, and with nothing for you to look into.
a3.p3s: Photos, video and listings in Germany, Norway and Sweden.
a3.p4s: Identified, vetted and interviewed in writing first.
a3.p6s: A video and a report every week.
a3.p7s: And it's exactly as you expected.
a4.h: Your home sits switched off eight months a year.
a4.sub: Mark the months you don't use it. The rest stay yours and nobody touches them.
a4.head: A year in your home
a4.foot: The grey blocks are months that earn nothing today. Activala switches them on. The ones marked “YOURS” stay yours and nobody touches them.
a5.h: The subscription that keeps your home alive.
a5.small: And only in the months it's let. With the home empty you pay nothing, there's no lock-in and we don't ask for exclusivity.
a5.s1: We only get paid when your home is active
a5.s4: You can stop whenever you like
a5.barco: We're in the same boat: if your home isn't earning, we don't get paid.
a6.h: We hand your home back just as you left it.
promesa: You get your home back exactly as you left it. If something breaks, we repair or replace it.
a7.h: How we choose who stays in your home
a7.sub: The same criteria for everyone, always about how the home is used — never about who the person is.
a7.r1p: With ID and their name on the contract. We know exactly who sleeps in your home.
a7.r2t: Payment always from the named tenant
a7.r2p: Never from a third party's account. It's the best fraud detector there is.
a7.r3t: Reason and length of stay documented
a7.r3p: Proof that their main residence is off the island. It's what holds the contract up before a judge.
a7.r4p: Not one person more than the home is approved for. No events and no subletting.
a7.r5t: A conversation before we confirm, in writing
a7.r5p: In their language, before we confirm. We have it with everyone, and it quickly shows who's coming and why.
a7.r6p: You set it in your home's file and it's not up for discussion. It's your home.
a8.f1b: Manages your home's whole life cycle
a8.f2a: Finishes once the keys are handed over
a8.f2b: Stays on until the tenant leaves
a8.f3a: Gets in touch when there's something to sign
a8.f4b: Gets paid only when your home is active
a9.h: Shall we switch your home on?
a9.sub: Tell us about it in a minute. No sign-up, no bank details, no obligation. We reply in your language.
f.donde: Where is the home? (complex or area)
f.meses: Which months would you like to come?
f.mensaje.ph: How many of you are coming, whether you need fast wifi, a pet…
f.consent.prop: I agree to Activala using these details to assess my home and contact me. I can ask for them to be deleted at any time. Privacy policy.
f.consent.inq: I agree to Activala using these details to send me available homes. I can ask for them to be deleted at any time. Privacy policy.
f.bajo.prop: We reply in your language, usually the same day.
f.bajo.inq: We reply within 48 hours, in your language.
f.msg.faltan: We're missing your name, email or WhatsApp.
f.msg.consent: We need you to accept the privacy policy so we can contact you.
f.msg.ok.prop: Received. We'll write to you in your language, usually the same day.
f.msg.ok.inq: Received. We'll write to you within 48 hours, in your language.
f.msg.error: The form couldn't be sent. Message us on WhatsApp and we'll sort it out.
q1.h:
The price you see
is the price you pay.
q1.lede: Real homes in the south of Gran Canaria, from one week to six months. One single price, with no agency fee. And someone on the island you can message in your language.
q1.cta1: Tell us which months you want
q2.h: Right now you're paying €1,200 for an advert on a portal.
q2.sub: Here's how a month's rent of €1,200 breaks down the usual way, and how it looks with us.
q2.c3b: Only the legal amount, and it comes back
q2.remate: The agency fee is the only one of those payments you never see again. With us it doesn't exist, because it's the owner who pays us.
q3.p2s: With video, not just photos, and the total price already worked out.
q3.p3s: You read it before paying anything. A booking payment and you're done.
q3.p4b: 4 · We open the door for you.
q3.p4s: Someone welcomes you and leaves you their WhatsApp.
q4.sub: One single number. No extras on arrival and no surprises when you leave.
q4.r1t: The home, ready to walk into
q4.r1p: Clean, with everything working, and check-in at the time you arrive.
q4.r2p: On arrival and on departure. For longer stays, we arrange the in-between cleans with you.
q4.r3p: Ready on the day you arrive. Nothing to bring and nothing to hire.
q4.r4p: If something goes wrong, we fix it. You send us a WhatsApp and that's it.
q4.r5p: Water, electricity and wifi within the fixed price. No meters to check.
q4.r6t: One person you can turn to
q4.r6p: On the island, with a name and a WhatsApp. You meet them the day we hand over the keys.
q5.h: Why you can book without knowing us
q5.sub: Booking a home from 3,000 km away takes trust. This is what it rests on.
q5.r1t: You see the home on video, not just photos
q5.r1p: Real, recent video of the very home you're booking. What you see is what's there.
q5.r2t: If it isn't the one in the video, we put it right
q5.r2p: We move you to another home or refund everything. No arguing.
q5.r3p: In your language, and you read it in full before parting with a single euro. A booking payment, and the rest on arrival.
q5.r4t: The deposit is the official one
q5.r4p: The amount the law sets, lodged where the law requires. And it comes back in full when you leave.
q5.r5p: The number you accept is the number you pay. No extras on arrival.
q5.r6p: We're on the island, with a name, a WhatsApp and homes in our care all year round.
q6.f1q: Do I need to know my exact dates?
q6.f1a: No. Tell us the months you're interested in and we'll show you what's free. Dates are settled when you choose a home.
q6.f2q: What do I pay, and when?
q6.f2a: A booking payment when you sign the contract, and the rest on arrival. Nothing else: no agency fee, no separate cleaning charge, no blocked card.
q6.f3a: Only what the law sets, and it comes back in full when you leave, provided the home is as you found it. No made-up extras.
q6.f4a: It depends on the home: each owner decides. Tell us when you enquire and we'll only show you homes that welcome pets.
q6.f5q: What if something breaks during my stay?
q6.f5a: You message us on WhatsApp and we fix it. Maintenance is included in the price.
q7.h: Tell us what you're looking for.
q7.sub: We'll write to you with homes that fit your dates. No obligation and nothing to pay.
